body.statement: Lemma 2. For every \(|s|\le1/2\), \[H^2(h_0,g_s)\le C_{\cos}s^4,\qquad C_{\cos}=64\pi^4/5.\] The priors in \(\mathrm{def:hard\text{-}subexperiment}\) are supported on \(\mathcal B_{0,r}(H)\) and \(\mathcal B_{1,r}(H,a^2)\), the marginal law of \(Z\) agrees, and \[H^2(P_{0,a},P_{1,a})\le C_{\cos}r\xi_Ha^4.\]
body.justification: Symmetric shifts cancel first-order information, and the eighth-order boundary controls support change.
body.gap: The design-based Le Cam and classical quadratic-prior papers do not prove this uniform assignment-conditional inequality.
body.consumer: The explicit constant evaluates every test and can be compared directly with the optimized motif variance.
